profile.headline: Parcel System Analyst
profile.summary: I am a technology professional with greater than 20 years of experience in SQL, Database, and Analytical development, seeking a new opportunity with a growth oriented organization that will value my enthusiasm for data-focused solutions.

positions.title: Parcel System Analyst
positions.description:
Stord is a leading provider of supply chain services and technology—including warehousing, transportation, and fulfillment, complemented by OMS and WMS software—for high-volume, omnichannel mid-market and enterprise brands. With Stord, brands can offer customers an exceptional delivery experience at scale while selling more cost-effectively, efficiently, and without headache. Hundreds of DTC and B2B companies like Athletic Greens, Native, Tula, American Giant, Branded, and Thrasio use Stord to make their supply chains a competitive advantage. 

Learn more about Stord, our business, and career opportunities at www.stord.com

positions.title: Senior SQL and Database Developer - Technical Lead
positions.description:
·  Developed and maintained batch processing procedures using T-SQL to ensure accurate and optimal setup of network configurations related to monthly postal changes, regional courier changes, new postal implementations, and logistical re-aggregations, reducing data entry time spent by business units by 90%.
·  Designed and executed more than 25 SQL queries per week for data analysis purposes as requested by business stakeholders, reducing customer data collection efforts by 35%.
·  Developed and maintained PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and materialized views related to bulk loading configurations and reporting of financial data.
·  Modeled and implemented inter-facility matrix, improving nationwide transportation network uptime from 98% to 99.9%.
·  Analyzed, identified, and routed out inconsistencies between OLTP and OLAP systems for deliveries and returns data across billions of rows of data, improving accuracy of BI reporting to 99.99%.
·  Developed and implemented RESTful API service pipelines using C#.NET for migrating data components from SQL Server legacy system to MongoDB in JSON format, improving warehouse API service performance by over 50%.
·  Implemented data mart and Power BI reporting infrastructure to monitor warehouse labor statistics, leading to a reduction in warehouse labor costs by over $2 million.  Included ETL builds for extracting and transforming data to XML format for 3rd party integration with Manhattan LMS.
·  Modeled logistics network data in SQL Server and Snowflake data warehouses, including proper extraction of data from source systems to ensure accurate data loads.
·  On-boarded and mentored offshore engineers in Poland and India, providing guidance related to data modeling, data extraction, SQL tuning, and SQL optimization, improving team productivity by 25%.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, Informatica and +17 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
·  Enhanced and supported proprietary back-end applications for billing, rating, fulfillment, and logistics network configurations in a full-stack development role.
·  Implemented critical back-end setups for new warehouse launches, including on-site visits to certify proper installation and go-live testing of applications.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
·  Built 12 Microsoft Excel VBA contract monitoring applications, used by monitors throughout the state of Texas for collecting over 10,000 data points. 
·  Developed 12 Microsoft SSIS ETL packages for processing raw data into QAI Data Lake for Department of Aging and Disability Services. 
·  Modeled, developed, and implemented over 400 staging and promotional tables in SQL Server and Oracle data warehouses.
·  Built a dozen Oracle PL/SQL packages as part of the data filtering and data cleansing process.

positions.title: IT Manager - .NET Applications & Retail Systems
positions.description:
·  Managed development team responsible for integration of customer, product, pricing, and inventory data between Golf Town and Golfsmith enterprise systems, as related to the Golf Town and Golfsmith merger.  Included interfaces for functions relating to distribution, inventory management, and sales.
·  Converted point-of-sale system in 7 Golf Town stores to Golfsmith’s proprietary point-of-sale system. 
·  Interfaced Golf Town's Retail Pro enterprise solution with Golfsmith's Oracle EBS for 57 Canadian stores.

positions.title: Software Application Developer - Technical Lead
positions.description:
·  Implemented interfaces from Golfsmith to Prodco and Dayforce service providers using Microsoft SSIS ETL packages, XML T-SQL, and SFTP for  management of retail personnel, sales, and in-store traffic data, reducing manual intervention of business units by over 95%.
·  Developed and maintained T-SQL automation scripts for managing SQL Server replications between corporate systems, 100 store servers, and more than 300 registers, reducing manual intervention by 75%.
·  Converted www.golfsmith.com back-end from Oracle to SQL Server, including migration of 200+ database procedures from PL/SQL to T-SQL, improving website performance by 20%.
·  Developed PL/SQL interfaces to integrate Motorola handheld scanners with Golfsmith’s back-end systems for in-store management of price changes, store transfers, and item price lookups.
·  Refactored over 100 T-SQL procedures for inventory replenishment system, improving database performance by 40%.  System was responsible for calculating replenishment quantities for over 300,000 items at the distribution and retail level.
·  Developed quarterly releases of Golfsmiths proprietary point-of-sale system to over 100 stores nationwide, including enhancements for custom club orders, credit card PCI compliance, club trade-in, and pricing promotions.  Involved web service deployments for shipping, tax calculations,  order lookups, and credit card  processing.
·  Installed and integrated ADP Taxware for use with Golfsmith’s point-of-sale system and www.golfsmith.com.
·  Managed 3 developers for reintegration of custom .NET applications due to implementation of Oracle R12 Applications.
positions.insights: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Modeling and +27 skills
